improvements_backlog.estimated_impact: reduce target_jump from 34m to <2m, prevent crash
improvements_backlog.rationale: When sim_time > trajectory.total_time (14.3s), target jumps 34m from trajectory end (x=52) to gate-2 (x=18). A blend/ramp over 2-3s would prevent violent maneuvering. Now that polynomial velocities are clamped, this is the highest-impact remaining issue.

Iter 3 proved progressive tracking enables full-course navigation, but gate-2 is missed by 1.29m (needs <0.6m). Improving racing line to thread ALL gates within detection range would allow progressive tracking + extended fallback to complete the entire course.

improvements_backlog.estimated_impact: better trajectory following at varying speeds
improvements_backlog.rationale: 0.3s fixed lookahead is conservative for slow segments and may overshoot on fast. Proportional to local curvature/speed would be better.

improvements_backlog.estimated_impact: reduce tumble risk during gate approach
improvements_backlog.rationale: gate_fallback uses min(dist*2, 5.0) which commands high speed until very close. A gentler decel profile would prevent overshoot and tumble.

Iter 3 progressive tracking showed drone crashing at t=25s in helix (alt 6.7→0.0m). Helix requires stable high-altitude flight with tight turns. May need reduced speed in helix or stronger altitude hold gains.

failed_approaches.description: Changed fallback trigger from sim_time > total_time to closest.time >= total_time - 0.05. Drone stayed in trajectory mode indefinitely because speed clamp means it never reaches trajectory end. Gates dropped from 4→1. Reverted.

Progressive closest-point tracking [-20,+150] window + 3x total_time fallback extension. Drone followed entire trajectory (100% trajectory mode, peak_ref_speed 10.00 m/s) but sequential gate sequencer only detected gate-1 (gate-2 at 1.29m > 0.6m threshold). Crashed at t=25.2s in helix (alt 6.7→0.0m). Gates 4→1. Reverted visual_demo changes; kept polynomial velocity clamp in trajectory_optimizer.py.

diagnostic.root_cause: Architectural: trajectory planned for 14.3s at 10 m/s, clamped to 5 m/s at command level. Drone traverses ~46% of trajectory before fallback triggers at t=14.3s. Fallback provides 54% of flight via direct-to-gate navigation with 34m target jumps. Polynomial velocity clamp (iter 3) fixed the reference speed issue but doesn't change the fundamental trajectory/fallback split.
